title: Moogle Stall Recipes - Forge Blueprints
note: kind: keyblade (grant: owned_keyblades bit) | form (grant: forms_unlocked bit) | deck (grant: +1 deck slot, deck_level). arc = minimum story_progress required. Materials reference material_catalog.json by id; qty is what the stall consumes. Ultima Weapon and Ultima Keyseal are forged, not found.

recipes.name: Kingdom Key
recipes.desc: The first keyblade, drawn by a boy on a drowned shore. The stall reforges it from what the dark shed.

recipes.name: Way to the Dawn
recipes.desc: Riku's road in blade form. Half light, half apology.

recipes.name: Wayward Wind
recipes.desc: Ventus's relic. It weighs nothing and blows everywhere you aim it.

recipes.name: Two Become One
recipes.desc: Roxas's blade - two halves that refuse to be cut apart again.

recipes.name: Oathkeeper
recipes.desc: A promise kept. The stall forges it from the light end of remembering.

recipes.name: Twilight Keyblade
recipes.desc: Granted by the flashback, not sold. The stall offers only to re-forge its twin.

recipes.name: Destiny's Embrace
recipes.desc: A princess's gift, drawn from the deep. The song is the material.

recipes.name: Kingdom Key D
recipes.desc: The King's blade, dark alloy of the clockwork sea.

recipes.name: Rainfell
recipes.desc: Aqua's blade, dried of ink. It still drips story.

recipes.name: Ultima Weapon
recipes.desc: The Forge of Worlds' blade, half-forged in a grinning cauldron. The stall finishes what the grin started.

recipes.name: Oblivion
recipes.desc: The dark half of the Twilight Keyblade, dragged from greed's cave.

recipes.name: Keyblade of People's Hearts
recipes.desc: A heart-shaped wound that chose a purpose.

recipes.name: Earthshaker
recipes.desc: The heaviest blade, wedged between the Hinge's jaws mid-slam.

recipes.name: No Name
recipes.desc: An old name, finally given. The machine's own heart pounded it out.

recipes.name: Bond of Flame
recipes.desc: Fire and fury, plucked from a thousand-mile stare.

recipes.name: Kingdom Key (XI)
recipes.desc: The copy that refused to be erased. The berserk moon lent it a crescent.

recipes.name: Ultima Keyseal
recipes.desc: The final keyblade of the final door. The Archon keeps the key piece of it - First Light - inside itself. Only its defeat opens this recipe's true cost.

recipes.name: Shadow Overdrive
recipes.desc: The heartless form. The stall binds your shadow with dusk shards until it obeys.

recipes.name: Ultima Drive
recipes.desc: The ultima form. Molten bell-metal and pumpkin wax, poured while the forge howls.

recipes.name: Twilight Form
recipes.desc: Five keyblades at once. The stall charges five times over - and cups the First Light like an egg.

recipes.name: Command Refinement I
recipes.desc: The stall re-threads your deck with Nobody thread. +1 command slot.

recipes.name: Command Refinement II
recipes.desc: Gears and chords, set ticking. +1 command slot.

recipes.name: Command Refinement III
recipes.desc: Piston-driven deck, sealed at both ends. +1 command slot.

recipes.name: Command Refinement IV
recipes.desc: The stall's masterpiece. +1 command slot, and you heard nothing about the Void Smoke.
